title: Reconcile roadmap after final lifecycle audit
rawUserRequest: 查收，全部对应，完成了以后自检，有问题再对应，循环到结束。每个WI都走完全流程。需要我授权的，授权给你，并写入contract。

rawRequestSource.reference: User-authorized continuation of the full remediation and Work Item lifecycle.

requestedOperation.authorityReason: The user explicitly authorized completing every corresponding Work Item, self-checking, correcting failures, and recording any required authorization in the Contract.
authorizedExternalEffects: Create/update the Work Item PR, run hosted checks, merge the PR, and close this Work Item after merge.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The roadmap count and status tables match the authoritative archive after this reconciliation is archived.
scenarioCoverage.expected: The roadmap records 36 archived entries before this WI and 37 after its archive transaction, with no archived Work Item presented as an uncreated Planned/Gated item.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Compare the edited roadmap counts, completed tables, and active-state text against archive/index.json before archive and assert the final merged main tree has 37 entries.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The reconciliation does not change product behavior or immutable historical evidence.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Only roadmap, scoped plan, and generated Work Item lifecycle evidence change; source, tests, dependencies, workflows, and existing archived records remain untouched.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run scope, diff ownership, diff check, check-ai-pr, and inspect the final PR diff against the out-of-scope paths.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: The Work Item completes the governed lifecycle with clean local and remote state.
scenarioCoverage.expected: Preflight, checkpoints, Finish, archive, PR checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, and final branch/worktree audit all pass.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run canonical lifecycle commands, hosted checks, merge, close, and final main/remote/archive assertions.

outOfScope: Changing archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or manifest contents
Changing AI Cockpit check implementations or weakening quality gates
Provider operations, credentials, external service calls, or production data writes

sources.reason: Authoritative archive index currently contains 36 entries and exposes the roadmap count drift.
Current roadmap contains a stale 35-entry snapshot after PR #36 merged.
Most recent archived Summary records the completed Cockpit cleanup and its final lifecycle boundary.
Repository governance requires evidence-bound lifecycle closure and clean state.
Canonical governance, quality, archive, and closure commands.
Defines generated no-active status and Work Item lifecycle behavior.
Scoped execution and acceptance plan for this status-only correction.

riskAssessment.reason: A stale roadmap can mislead future sequencing, while overcorrecting it could invent Work Items or mutate immutable evidence. The correction is limited to archive-index-derived status text and a scoped plan.
riskAssessment.reviewedBy: Codex under the user's explicit full-lifecycle remediation authorization
riskAssessment.destructiveChangeReview: No files are deleted; only evidence-backed roadmap status text and lifecycle records are changed.

reasons: Initial Work Item skeleton defaults to Standard until scope is classified.

executionDecision.reason: The archive index provides authoritative current counts, the roadmap drift is directly evidenced, and the documentation-only correction has bounded acceptance and verification.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: The roadmap's snapshot and completed/active status text match the authoritative 36-entry archive before this WI and the final 37-entry archive after this WI is archived.
No existing archived Contract, Summary, Outcome, or manifest is modified, and no uncreated Work Item remains presented as Planned or Gated implementation work.
Only the declared roadmap, plan, and generated lifecycle evidence are changed; no source, tests, dependencies, workflows, or quality gates are changed.
All declared AI Cockpit checks and make quality pass, followed by hosted PR checks, merge, ai-close-work-item, and final clean-state audit.
guidelines: Keep roadmap status evidence-backed by the authoritative archive index.
Do not hand-edit generated current_status.md; regenerate it through Make targets.
Do not modify archived Work Item records while reconciling navigation documentation.

intent.problem: After PR #36 added the 36th archived Work Item, docs/superpowers/plans/2026-08-17-orgx-wi-roadmap.md still states that the archive will contain 35 entries. This makes the navigation and progress snapshot inconsistent with the authoritative archive index.
constraints: Derive counts and completed status from .ai/work-items/archive/index.json; do not invent or delete Work Items.
Preserve all existing archived Work Item records and do not change product code, tests, dependencies, workflows, or provider behavior.
Use the canonical Work Item lifecycle and record the user's granted scope for PR, hosted checks, merge, and close.
intent.rationale: Updating the roadmap from the archive index restores a truthful navigation snapshot while keeping the archive immutable and the correction isolated from runtime behavior.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: Set only when a human explicitly approves restricted governance paths.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff and restore related tests and docs.
